purpose: Teach: 洋子/四郎/敦/小僧/無題/赤色/紗子/和子

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお母様のお友達洋子さんを紹介して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father said he'd like to introduce you to Youko, your mother's friend.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Words placed carefully, like she's offering him something precious. Slight pause before the name Youko. Warm and observant—noticing how he might receive this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと四郎さんのお墓参りに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I went to visit Dad's and Shiro's graves with Dad.
lines.style: Small voice, but steady. Pride underneath—the kind of thing a boy carries quietly. Matter-of-fact delivery, but the weight of it sits there. No rush.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「敦くんとも遊びましょう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said, 'You should come play with Atsushi too.'
lines.style: Light and deliberate. She's reporting his words like they matter—because they do. A small smile underneath. Not rushing; letting him absorb it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「若い小僧だな」って親しまれたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, Dad called me a 'young guy' in a really... kind of nice way.
lines.style: Quiet, searching for the right word. A small laugh caught in the middle—not quite believing it but wanting to believe it. The tenderness of being seen by an adult.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「絵を無題のまま展示する勇気もある」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said you have real courage—showing your art untitled like that.
lines.style: Serious now, but not heavy. She's translating something important. Slight emphasis on 'courage.' The kind of thing a boy needs to hear said out loud. Still gentle, but with conviction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと赤色の風船を空に放したよ
lines.en: Mei-san, Dad and I let a red balloon go up into the sky together.
lines.style: Soft, almost reverent. The memory is vivid to him. Held breath on 'sky'—like he's watching it float away again. Small wonder in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「紗子ちゃんは賢いね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said Sako is really bright, you know.
lines.style: Reflective, like she's turning something over in her mind. Gentle emphasis on Sako's name. Not idle gossip—this is her noticing his father notice someone Sho cares about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと和子おばさんの家でお茶飲んだよ
lines.en: Mei-san, Dad and I had tea at Aunt Kazuko's house.
lines.style: Comfortable and close, like he's sharing something ordinary that feels safe. A small contentment in the voice. The intimacy of being included in an adult's day.
